description: Fix the Harness GitHub Actions CI job so unittest discovery finds the src layout and runtime dependencies: scripts/check-harness.sh must export PYTHONPATH=src for the unittest discover invocation, and the workflow must install the pinned runtime dependencies (sqlalchemy==2.1.3, alembic==1.20.0 recorded in ADR-0002 and pyproject.toml) before running the harness check; currently CI fails with ModuleNotFoundError 'poker' and 'sqlalchemy' while the same command passes locally only because the local check runner sets a private environment.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/check-harness.sh invokes unittest discovery with PYTHONPATH=src (exported for all three script steps or at minimum for the unit-test step), without weakening any of its existing fail-closed steps.
The GitHub workflow installs the pinned runtime dependencies before running harness checks (no floating versions; pins match pyproject.toml and ADR-0002).

A regression test (or equivalent deterministic check) asserts the workflow/check script contract: PYTHONPATH=src present in the unittest invocation, dependency install step present and pinned, so a future regression to discovery-path or missing-deps fails the test first.
The repo local deterministic suite is unchanged or green (715 tests), and the CI contract test introduced is included.

origin.source: GitHub Actions run on main after POKER-PR-FLOW-001 record push: job failed with ModuleNotFoundError 'poker' (cards/db/domain test modules) and 'sqlalchemy' (db tests) because scripts/check-harness.sh runs unittest discovery without PYTHONPATH=src and the workflow installs no dependencies; 454 tests discovered, 5 module-import errors, exit 1
origin.user_authorization: Repository owner reported the failing CI run in orchestrator session and requested the fix; this task also serves as the first end-to-end exercise of the blocking-PR publication flow (publish_pr.py)

planning.title: Fix CI: PYTHONPATH for src layout + pinned dependency install
planning.notes: Publication of this task exercises the new mode 'pr' blocking-PR flow end to end: publication pushes agent branch and opens a PR against main; the human merges (merge-commit or rebase, never squash); publish_pr finalize completes closure. gh CLI availability must be verified during EXPLORE before any PR-mode publication is planned.
